# Lab 15.1: Model Data as a Graph

## What We Are Going to Do
Create node and edge tables for people, accounts and money transfers, then turn them into a property graph with `CREATE PROPERTY GRAPH`.

## Steps

1. **[CLI] Create the dataset.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">bq --location=US mk --dataset $PROJECT_ID:lab15</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


2. **[SQL] Create node tables.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE lab15.Person (id INT64, name STRING, city STRING, PRIMARY KEY (id) NOT ENFORCED);
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE lab15.Account (id INT64, is_blocked BOOL, nick_name STRING, PRIMARY KEY (id) NOT ENFORCED);

INSERT INTO lab15.Person VALUES (1,'Alex','Surat'),(2,'Dana','Pune'),(3,'Lee','Delhi'),(4,'Meera','Mumbai');
INSERT INTO lab15.Account VALUES (7,FALSE,'Vacation'),(16,TRUE,'Vacation'),(20,FALSE,'Rainy Day'),(30,FALSE,'Business');</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


3. **[SQL] Create edge tables.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE lab15.PersonOwnAccount (
  id INT64, account_id INT64, create_time TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (id, account_id) NOT ENFORCED,
  FOREIGN KEY (id) REFERENCES lab15.Person(id) NOT ENFORCED,
  FOREIGN KEY (account_id) REFERENCES lab15.Account(id) NOT ENFORCED);

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE lab15.AccountTransferAccount (
  id INT64, to_id INT64, amount FLOAT64, create_time TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (id, to_id, create_time) NOT ENFORCED,
  FOREIGN KEY (id) REFERENCES lab15.Account(id) NOT ENFORCED,
  FOREIGN KEY (to_id) REFERENCES lab15.Account(id) NOT ENFORCED);

INSERT INTO lab15.PersonOwnAccount VALUES
 (1,7,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP()),(2,20,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP()),(3,16,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP()),(4,30,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP());
INSERT INTO lab15.AccountTransferAccount VALUES
 (7,16,300,TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01'),(16,20,250,TIMESTAMP '2026-01-02'),(20,7,200,TIMESTAMP '2026-01-03'),
 (20,30,500,TIMESTAMP '2026-01-04'),(30,16,80,TIMESTAMP '2026-01-05');</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


4. **[SQL] Create the graph.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">CREATE OR REPLACE PROPERTY GRAPH lab15.FinGraph
  NODE TABLES (
    lab15.Person LABEL Person,
    lab15.Account LABEL Account
  )
  EDGE TABLES (
    lab15.PersonOwnAccount
      SOURCE KEY (id) REFERENCES Person (id)
      DESTINATION KEY (account_id) REFERENCES Account (id)
      LABEL Owns,
    lab15.AccountTransferAccount
      SOURCE KEY (id) REFERENCES Account (id)
      DESTINATION KEY (to_id) REFERENCES Account (id)
      LABEL Transfers
  );</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


5. **[Console] Find the graph.** In Explorer, `lab15` now shows `FinGraph` with its own icon. Open it to see nodes, edges, labels and properties.

## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Nodes | Person, Account |
| Edges | Owns, Transfers |
| Storage | No copy; the graph is defined over the tables |
| Keys | Primary keys identify nodes and edges |
